member.name: M:GearSpawner.GearSpawnManager.GameManager_ApplyCurrentQualitySettings
member.summary: Other than GameManager.SetAudioModeForLoadedScene(), QualitySettingsManager.ApplyCurrentQualitySettings is the last method called within GameManager.Update() before save file saving and loading occur. They only get called after the loading panel has closed, and they each only get called once. If GameManager.SetAudioModeForLoadedScene() was not inlined, it would be used instead.
